title: `format`
description: A semantic format hint on a string parameter.
question: Is the format constraint present at each capture boundary?
notes: All measured `format` values survive at four capture boundaries. CrewAI preserves `email` and `date-time` inside optional wrappers but drops `uri` from the string branch of the destination `anyOf`.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: `email` and `date-time` remain inside generated optional wrappers; `destination.anyOf[0].format: uri` is absent from the generated `args_schema`.

verdict.headline: Fully preserved at four boundaries, partly preserved at one.
verdict.detail: CrewAI keeps two measured formats but drops `uri` inside a union branch.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Losing it can allow malformed emails, timestamps, or URIs to reach your server.
